method: Bounded retained-CIL replay of DNCg/zNPc/fNPD/vNPI/FNCR with explicit output and geometry-provider sinks; not original Axure execution.
boundaries: Escaping/ID prefix providers use safe ASCII identity fixtures; they are not asserted byte-equivalent.
Shape writer call boundary is captured separately; its full image/CSS generation is not executed.
vNPI uses no reference view, no IX variants, no raster asset and deterministic provider flags.
Native rich payload, text measurement, pixel layout and complete base stylesheet remain opaque sinks.
No final browser-computed overflow is asserted.
